title: Fire Alarm System Installation | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Fire Alarm System Installation. Category: Vocational Training Courses. Duration: 3 months. Description: Covers wiring of fire system equipment, types of fire alarm systems, smoke detectors, fire classification, and types of fire extinguishers. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
